verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents configurable Decision Center policies at the Sale checkpoint. Nothing in the evidence describes backtesting or simulating a rule against historical traffic, or reporting what it would have blocked, flagged, or cost. Test teams are an adjacent isolation mechanism for live test orders, not historical rule replay, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, I can backtest a rule against my historical traffic before deploying it, seeing exactly what it would have blocked, flagged, and cost
